description: This file defines a PHP class 'Sass' that extends a controller class, responsible for compiling and generating CSS from SCSS files within the OpenCart admin interface. It contains logic to process all .scss files in a specific directory, compile them if needed, and save the resulting CSS files.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart admin system responsible for compiling SCSS files into CSS.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the compilation of all .scss files in the stylesheet directory. Checks if compiled CSS files already exist or if SASS compilation is enabled, then compiles SCSS files to CSS and writes them to disk.
